## Cyber Security Operations Coordinator
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and proactive Cyber Security Operations Coordinator to lead the coordination and response to complex cyber security incidents, threat hunting investigations, and cross-functional security operations. This role plays a critical part in safeguarding organisational systems and data by driving incident response activities, advising leadership on operational matters, and contributing to strategic security planning. The ideal candidate is a technically proficient security professional with strong coordination capabilities, sound analytical judgement, and the ability to communicate complex security issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
## Key Responsibilities
- Lead the end-to-end investigation and response to cyber security incidents, including containment, mitigation, and recovery activities, ensuring timely resolution and minimal operational disruption
- Direct threat hunting operations to proactively identify threat vectors, develop threat models, and build security cases that inform defensive strategies across the organisation
- Analyse security risks, vulnerabilities, and emerging threats, translating findings into actionable security plans and technical controls aligned with the organisation's security architecture
- Coordinate and manage tasks across multiple teams during incident response and threat hunt engagements, ensuring clear communication, accountability, and effective workflow throughout each operation
- Advise senior leadership on the status of current security operations, ongoing collaborations, and key findings, contributing meaningfully to strategic security planning and policy development
- Develop and communicate key messaging around security incidents and threat intelligence, ensuring accurate and timely information is delivered to the appropriate stakeholders
- Oversee the collection, preservation, and forensic analysis of digital evidence in accordance with established procedures and chain-of-custody requirements
- Implement and maintain technical security controls that align with the organisation's security strategies, frameworks, and compliance obligations
- Perform ongoing threat management activities, monitoring threat landscapes and updating security models to reflect evolving attack techniques and adversary behaviours
- Facilitate and coordinate security awareness training programmes for staff, promoting a security-conscious culture across the organisation
- Maintain detailed records of incident response activities, investigation findings, and operational outcomes to support continuous improvement and audit readiness
- Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to uphold the integrity, confidentiality, and availability of organisational systems and information assets
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Cyber Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
- Demonstrated experience in a cyber security operations, incident response, or threat intelligence role, with exposure to coordinating cross-functional teams
- Strong working knowledge of incident response methodologies, threat hunting techniques, and digital forensics processes
- Experience conducting security risk assessments, vulnerability analyses, and developing actionable remediation plans
- Proficiency with security tools and platforms such as SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, and threat intelligence feeds
- Solid understanding of security frameworks and standards, including NIST, ISO 27001, or the Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) Essential Eight
- Demonstrated ability to analyse and interpret complex technical information and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
- Strong project coordination and task management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a high-pressure environment
- Sound understanding of network security, endpoint protection, identity and access management, and cloud security principles
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience producing professional reports, briefings, and incident documentation
## Preferred Qualifications
- Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CEH, GIAC (e.g. GCIH, GCFA), or CompTIA Security+
- Experience working within a Security Operations Centre (SOC) environment or managed security services setting
- Familiarity with Australian regulatory and compliance requirements, including the Privacy Act, Notifiable Data Breaches scheme, and relevant sector-specific obligations
- Exposure to threat intelligence platforms, malware analysis, or reverse engineering
- Experience contributing to the development of security policies, procedures, or organisational security awareness programmes
- Prior experience briefing or advising senior leadership or executive stakeholders on cyber security matters
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking security team where your contributions directly shape the organisation's cyber resilience
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for industry certifications, training programmes, and conference attendance
- Enjoy a flexible working environment that supports work-life balance, including hybrid work arrangements
- Competitive remuneration package with superannuation, reflective of your skills and experience
- Work within a values-driven organisation committed to innovation, integrity, and building a diverse and inclusive workplace
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation

Welcome to Sunquest Signs
Sunquest Signs is a well-established Australian signage company delivering high-quality signage solutions across commercial, industrial, government and infrastructure sectors.
We specialise in designing, manufacturing and installing custom signage solutions while building long-term relationships through exceptional customer service, technical expertise and professional project delivery.
As our business continues to expand into new markets, we are seeking an experienced Project Administrator (Client Manager) to coordinate multiple signage projects from initial client consultation through to successful project completion.
This is a senior professional position responsible for project planning, commercial coordination, client relationship management and operational administration, ensuring projects are delivered safely, efficiently, on schedule and within budget.
 
About the Role
Reporting directly to senior management, the Project Administrator (Client Manager) is responsible for planning, coordinating and administering multiple concurrent signage projects throughout the complete project lifecycle.
The role requires responsibility for coordinating project schedules, allocating resources, monitoring budgets, preparing estimates, managing client communication, coordinating production and installation activities, maintaining project documentation and ensuring compliance with company procedures and workplace legislation.
The successful applicant will play a key role in ensuring commercial success while maintaining exceptional client service and operational excellence.
 
Key Responsibilities
Project Planning & Administration
•	Plan, coordinate and administer multiple signage projects from commencement through to completion. 
•	Develop detailed project schedules and implementation plans. 
•	Coordinate project activities across design, production, procurement and installation teams. 
•	Monitor project milestones and ensure deliverables are achieved within agreed timelines. 
•	Maintain comprehensive project documentation and administrative records. 
•	Monitor project performance and recommend corrective actions where required. 
•	Coordinate internal resources and external contractors to optimise project delivery. 
•	Prepare project reports for management and clients. 
Client Relationship Management
•	Manage client enquiries from initial consultation through to project completion. 
•	Interpret client specifications and project requirements. 
•	Develop and maintain strong professional relationships with clients, consultants and stakeholders. 
•	Coordinate client meetings, project updates and approval processes. 
•	Manage project variations and changes to project scope. 
•	Resolve project issues professionally while maintaining exceptional customer service. 
Commercial Administration & Estimating
•	Prepare accurate quotations, cost estimates and project proposals. 
•	Assess project specifications, labour requirements, materials and production costs. 
•	Monitor project expenditure against approved budgets. 
•	Maintain agreed gross profit margins. 
•	Coordinate purchase orders, project costing and final invoicing through Xero. 
•	Assist management with commercial planning, pricing strategies and profitability analysis. 
Production & Design Coordination
•	Coordinate artwork development and client approval processes. 
•	Prepare production-ready artwork for manufacture or approved external suppliers.

At Riot, we believe in putting players first. Our Sydney-based team is partnering globally to build next-generation features and technology on an exciting Unpublished R&D Title. The team focuses on supporting the game's visual targets and content production needs - helping our artists to realize a vibrant and rich world for players to be immersed and express themselves in.

As a Senior Technical Artist, Tools & Pipeline, you’ll shape the creative engine that powers our teams - defining and elevating end-to-end workflows across disciplines including Character Art, Animation, Environment Art, Audio, and VFX. You’ll be a strategic partner to artists, Technical Art, and Engineering, evaluating tools and pipelines, clarifying production requirements, and ensuring our workflows enable creativity at scale. Your work will directly impact how ideas move from concept to shipped content, empowering multiple teams to operate efficiently in parallel production streams.

In this role, you’ll help stand up and sustain scalable tools and processes, providing hands-on technical support while gathering data and feedback to continuously improve the artist experience. You’ll build strong cross-disciplinary relationships to uncover pain points and guide meaningful system and pipeline improvements. As an active member of Riot’s Technical Art community, you’ll mentor fellow TAs, contribute to craft growth, and foster a culture of knowledge sharing through clear documentation and open feedback. By setting clear goals, offering actionable direction, and championing continuous improvement, you’ll ensure our workflows not only support today’s production but evolve to meet the ambitions of tomorrow.

You will report to the Manager, Technical Art, and work closely with the Technical Art Director and other members of the team abroad.

Responsibilities:
Define and level up the end-to-end workflow for our many creative disciplines, such as Character Art, Animation, Environment Art, Audio, and VFX
Collaborate with Technical Art and Engineering partners to support artist needs, including evaluating tools and workflows, and communicating requirements for production.
Help stand up and maintain scalable artist tools and workflows to support multiple teams in parallel production streams.
Provide technical support to artists working from our art workflows, collecting data to further improve the tools they are using, making recommendations and improvements where necessary
Be an active member of the Tech Art community within Riot, participate in craft-focused meetings and events, and actively mentor for other Technical Artists in their craft
Build close relationships with artists and engineers to understand needs, identify pain points, and help guide workflow, pipeline, and system improvements.
Spread knowledge of the team’s processes through documentation and help teams expand their technical know-how
Consistently give and take constructive feedback, direct next steps, and communicate clear goals and outcomes to your team

Required Qualifications: 
6+ years of professional experience as a technical artist in games or related industries.
Professional experience in content creation and tool development for DCC tools, such as Autodesk Maya, 3DS Max, Adobe Suite, ZBrush, Houdini, Substance Suite, or Blender.
Professional experience working in Unreal Engine 5.
Highly proficient in Python tool development, with a particular focus on building scalable, maintainable, and high-performance tools for a variety of artist use-cases.
Professional experience with modern UI frameworks such as PySide & PyQt.
Strong understanding of art workflows and the ability to translate artistic needs into technical requirements.
Highly proficient communication skills and capacity to act as an ambassador between art and engineering.
Superb critical thinking skills, particularly as it pertains to translating artistic requirements to sustainable workflow design.
Proactive, responsible, and comfortable owning ambiguous or evolving problem spaces.

Desired Qualifications:
Experience with C++ and UMG for Unreal Engine 5.
Excellent UI/UX design and front-end development (especially Qt/PyQt).
Strong understanding of performance considerations for modern hardware and optimization techniques required for delivering a scalable, high performance product.
Experience working on a large-scale, AAA game with a sizable, cross-disciplinary team.
Experience with character rigging and animation pipelines.

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

Join our dynamic team today and start your journey in the state that feels like home.

Offshore Staff Assist is currently hiring for a broad range of positions across various sectors on behalf of our client. We recognize your enthusiasm for becoming a part of our team and are keen to support your professional development. Our focus on excellence and innovation is at the core of our business, offering a solid foundation for your skills to develop and succeed. 
We are not just offering jobs, but long-term career opportunities that promise growth and advancement within the company and into Australia. If you're looking for a role where your contributions are valued and your professional growth is a priority, please join us to build a future where your career aspirations align with our commitment to progress and hard work.
We're currently looking for qualified:

•	Metal Fabricator
•	Welder 
•	Sheet Metal Trades Worker
•	Vehicle Body Builder
•	Fitter and Turner
•	Fitter-Welder
•	Pressure Welder 
•	Metal Machinist 
•	CNC Machinist

To be considered for the below roles, you must have a minimum 3 years’ experience.

Metal Fabricator
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in interpreting engineering drawings and blueprints, coupled with a solid understanding of metal properties and machinery. Your role will involve cutting, bending, and assembling metal structures and equipment through the use of welders, cutters, shapers, and measuring tools. You will be responsible for producing metal products according to clients specifications. Attention to detail, precision, and a safety-first attitude are paramount for success in this role.

Welder
Experienced and proficient Welder to become part of our welding department. This position demands proficiency in using various welding techniques (MIG, TIG, MMA) and equipment to join, surface, fabricate, and repair parts of metal or other weldable materials. The ideal candidate will have a keen eye for detail, with extensive knowledge of welding procedures and safety measures. You will work on a variety of projects, ensuring that final products meet the highest quality standards and are completed within the designated timeline.

Sheet Metal Trades Worker

We require Sheet Metal Trades Workers that can study blueprints, drawings and specifications to determine job, material and equipment requirements. Select metal stock, such as stainless steel, galvanised iron, mild steel, aluminium and copper, and checking sizes, gauges and other dimensions of metal stock against specifications. Mark out metal stock with reference points and lines, using templates, gauges and other measuring instruments. Cut metal stock along guidelines using hand and power shears, guillotines and drills

Vehicle Body Builder

We are looking for Vehicle Body Builders that can manufacture and repair prototype production units and purpose-built vehicle bodies such as buses, trucks, fire engines and caravans. Constructing framework sections in metal wood fibreglass and other materials using shaping machines and cutting and welding equipment. Cutting and shaping panels of Sheetmetal aluminium and reinforced plastic and attaching to frameworks using hand and power tools

Fitter and Turner
Join our dynamic team as a Fitter and Turner, where you will be responsible for fabricating, fitting, and machining mechanical parts to assemble or repair mechanical systems. The role demands precision and attention to detail, with extensive knowledge of machine operation and material properties.

Fitter-Welder
We require a skilled Fitter-Welder to carry out both fitting tasks and welding operations according to project needs. Candidates should have proficiency in various welding techniques and the ability to read and interpret blueprints and technical drawings. Experience in metal fabrication and a keen eye for quality are essential.

Pressure Welder
We are looking for a specialised Pressure Welder to support our operations with expertise in high-pressure vessels and piping . The role requires advanced knowledge and experience in welding processes that are crucial for the integrity of pressure vessels, boilers, and high-pressure piping systems. Candidates must possess the ability to read and interpret blueprints and standards related to pressure welding, ensuring compliance with both internal and external regulations and standards. This position demands high precision and adherence to strict safety and quality controls.

Metal Machinist
In this role, you will operate and maintain a variety of machines to produce precision parts and instruments. Key responsibilities include interpreting drawings, setting up mills and lathes, and conducting tests on completed tasks to ensure they meet specifications. The ideal candidate will have a comprehensive understanding of metal properties and machining techniques, combined with problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently.

CNC Machinist
This role involves programming, setting up, and operating CNC machines to produce high-quality parts and tools from metal, plastic, or other materials. The successful candidate will have in-depth knowledge of computer numerical control (CNC) machinery operations and processes, as well as an understanding of CAD/CAM software. Precision, attention to detail, and the ability to read and interpret mechanical documents and blueprints are essential. You will be instrumental in ensuring that our production goals are met with efficiency and high standards of quality.

result.description:
Our valued client SMW-Shutdowns, Maintenance & Welding based in Rockhampton is a proud Central Queensland provider of field servicing, maintenance and emergency repair / rebuild services. They have over 10 years' experience servicing the Central Queensland region.

SMW is seeking highly experienced Welders to join and work with their friendly team of professionals on a full time and permanent basis.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Read and interpret project plans, engineering drawings, blueprints and other written instructions and diagrams to perform task at hand
Perform fabrication and repair works on various metal structures and components according to engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Work with variety of materials, including steel, aluminium, and other alloys
Weld small and large components such as copper plumbing, beams, and pipelines.
Perform appropriate type of weld - base on project needs and specifications
Weld components in flat, vertical, and overhead positions.
Ensure fabrication and repairs are carried out using the proper safety guidelines to ensure rework jobs do not occur.
Use a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Conduct quality checks on completed work to ensure it meets standard specifications
Monitor machinery for appropriate usage and temperature
Follow and enforce strict safety regulations such as wearing heat-resistant gloves, protective masks, and safety shoes to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace.

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Trade certificate in Engineering Fabrication or Equivalent
Proficient in performing all welding, gouging, cutting or other duties
Post trade experience in the same field
Proactive attitude with the desire to work reliably as part of an outstanding team to deliver excellence for our clients
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Experience working with a variety of materials, including steel, aluminum, and other alloys
Familiarity with a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Strong attention to detail and the ability to conduct quality checks on completed work
Ability to work independently or as part of a team to complete assigned tasks
Knowledge of safety procedures and regulations to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace
Strong communication and reporting skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $75,000 and $80,000 per annum + Super
